View the slot allocation and final qualifying times at Ironman Copenhagen 2024.

*   Slot allocations calculated from adjusted finishing times.
*   Final qualifying time is the finishing time of the last place that is automatically be entitled to a slot.

Ironman Copenhagen 2024 has multiple Championship qualification slots. The allocation for the latest Championship is calculated by default.
